title: Biomarker-s of Abusive Head Trauma by Proteomics
official: Identification of Novel Biomarker-s of Abusive Head Trauma on Serum by Proteomics
summary: The aim of our study is to highlight biomarker-s of Abusive Head Trauma by proteomics analyses on the serum of child victims of abuse.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age : 0-2 y.o
* Medical consultation for malaise, seizure (without fever), loss of consciousness, traumatic bain injury, or cranioplasty
* Blood test during medical care
* Accepted informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refused informed consent
* For control groups : medical history of child abuse
* For AHT group : rare metabolic disease (Menkes, etc..)
